headline: Datamatics Global Services reports Q2FY27 revenue of Rs 546.6 crore and PAT of Rs 73.4 crore
hook: Profit growth outpaces revenue in Q2
summary: Datamatics Global Services announced its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Operating revenue rose 11.5 percent year-on-year to Rs 546.6 crore. Net profit (PAT) increased 16.1 percent year-on-year to reach Rs 73.4 crore. Retail investors tracking the IT and BPM sector can use these figures to assess the company's margin expansion.
why_it_matters: Earnings growth signals steady operational performance for shareholders.
